title: Teri Talash Mein (dub)(unnaruge Naan Irundhal Tamil)
desc: After her father's sudden death, Mahalakshmi is left to clear his debts and face the harsh villagers. A taxi driver helps her cremate her father and pledges his taxi to earn her a temporary reprieve.

title: No Smoking
desc: A heavily addicted smoker is unprepared for the true price he must pay when he asks a guru's help to kick the habit.

title: Omkara
desc: A crime drama based on William Shakespeare's play "Othello". The film follows Omkara, a powerful and feared gangster who trusts his lieutenant , Langda more than anyone. However, Langda plots against Omkara, manipulating him into believing his wife has been unfaithful. The film explores themes of jealousy, betrayal, and revenge, and features powerful performances and intense action sequences.

title: Maqbool
desc: In Mumbai's criminal underworld, the lord of all lords is Jahangir Khan (Pankaj Kapoor). Those loyal to him include Maqbool (Irfan Khan), his chief. But Maqbool is in love with Nimmi (Tabu), Jahangir's mistress, who convinces him to be ambitious and take over the empire. After maneuvering potential rivals out of the way, Maqbool betrays Jahangir, murdering him in his own bed. However, it isn't long before both Maqbool and Nimmi are haunted by the ghosts of their treacherous deeds.

title: Gali Gali Chor Hai
desc: Bharat, a small-time artist, finds himself dealing with the effects of a corrupt system. In the process, he himself discovers his ideals and decides to fight for the rights of the common people.
